trends.name: Iran-Israel Escalation & Oil Supply Risk
trends.summary: Real-time military escalation between Iran and Israel with airstrikes on Iranian shipbuilding and Lebanese targets. Markets pricing catastrophic tail risk for oil prices as Iran retains half its missile launchers and thousands of drones. Strait of Hormuz tensions threaten critical global energy chokepoint amid 'low odds of off-ramps' per energy executives.

trends.name: Fed Holds Rates Through 2026
trends.summary: Markets now pricing zero Fed rate cuts in 2026 as most likely outcome, with odds rising sharply. Wells Fargo reversed prior two-cut forecast to expect no cuts. Rising oil-driven inflation combined with firm 4.25% unemployment creates dual-mandate constraint preventing Fed easing.

trends.name: AI Memory Supercycle & Semiconductor Demand
trends.summary: Micron Technology and semiconductor sector positioned for AI memory supercycle as data center buildout accelerates. OpenAI's $122B fundraise signals continued massive capex for AI infrastructure. Japanese retail flows into US AI stocks remain key funding source for current account deficit.

trends.name: Bond Market Outflows & Credit Stress
trends.summary: Investment-grade corporate bond funds saw -$5.35B outflow (largest since April 2025), signaling credit market stress and investor de-risking. Only second outflow in 12 months marks shift in fixed income sentiment amid higher rates and inflation concerns.

trends.name: S&P 500 Index Changes & Rebalancing
trends.summary: S&P 500 composition shift imminent with multiple stocks positioned as contenders for index inclusion. Sector rotation underway with energy stocks falling and space stocks rising, reshuffling fund flows and passive positioning.

trends.name: Tesla Downside Risk & EV Valuation
trends.summary: JPMorgan analyst warns Tesla stock could fall another 60% from current levels, citing 'high degree of caution' on valuation and growth trajectory. Signals broader EV sector valuation concerns amid competition and macro headwinds.

trends.name: Apple & Mac Innovation Catalyst
trends.summary: Apple stock identified with potential 20% upside catalyzed by MacBook Neo product cycle. AI-enabled Mac refresh cycle could drive hardware upgrade supercycle similar to iPhone dynamics.

trends.name: Agentic AI Growth & Enterprise Software
trends.summary: Okta and enterprise software sector positioned to benefit from agentic AI transition where autonomous agents automate workflows. Next growth phase shift from generative AI to autonomous decision-making systems.

trends.name: Meta Valuation Debate & AI Capex
trends.summary: Conflicting analyst views on Meta: bulls pushing 'double down' narrative on AI infrastructure investments vs. rating downgrade on profitability concerns. Massive capex spending creating short-term earnings headwinds despite growth narrative.

trends.name: OpenAI IPO Confidence & $122B Valuation
trends.summary: OpenAI CEO and CFO express confidence on imminent IPO following $122B fundraise round. Signals continued investor appetite for AI infrastructure despite macro concerns and validates continued AI capital intensity.

trends.name: Trump Accounts & Fintech Distribution
trends.summary: BNY Mellon and Robinhood emerging as early winners in Trump Accounts (new tax-advantaged savings tool). Fintech platforms gaining distribution advantage in wealth management, reshaping traditional banking relationships.

trends.name: Emerging Market Rotation & GEM Flows
trends.summary: Global emerging market equity fund flows declining sharply after decade-high 8-week net buying period. Signals potential pivot away from emerging markets following strongest inflows, suggesting capital rotation back to US equities or defensive positioning.
